objective: Correct Linux self-update local revision authority and close CI/package version drift without mutating accepted Windows R40 runtime.

rootCause.finding: Public R40/Linux R13 post-publish update check reported current 4.2.0-linux.13-r40 but localRevision=12, causing false updateAvailable=true for the same R13 asset.
rootCause.cause: update_check() retained hard-coded local_rev=12 while VERSION/package advanced to R13.
prevention: Local Linux revision is derived from VERSION by a dedicated parser.
Unparseable local VERSION fails closed with LOCAL_LINUX_REVISION_UNPARSEABLE.
Regression covers same revision, newer revision, malformed local revision, Linux asset filtering.
Hosted linux-static now builds current Linux R14 package instead of historical R12.

pending: exact Linux R14 live install/update/route/external-tun acceptance
